description.zh: 额外的请求参数，使用 JSON 字符串表示。支持自然语言处理，分镜，自定义标签，动作识别等算子的额外参数。
description.en: A JSON string containing additional parameters for operators such as natural language processing, shot detection, custom tagging, and action recognition.

description.zh: 模板 ID 用于指定分析算法，模板相关操作参见[创建用户自定义模板](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ims/developer-reference/api-ice-2020-11-09-createcustomtemplate?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-193643.d_5_0_3_3_0_0.17b66afamjKySv)和[智能标签模版](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ims/user-guide/smart-tagging-template?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i15)
description.en: The ID of the template that specifies the analysis algorithms to use. For more information about managing templates, see [Create Custom Template](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ims/developer-reference/api-ice-2020-11-09-createcustomtemplate?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-193643.d_5_0_3_3_0_0.17b66afamjKySv) and [AI-powered tagging template](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ims/user-guide/smart-tagging-template?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.i15).

description.zh: 视频标题，支持中英文、数字、中划线（-），不能以特殊符号开头，长度不能超过 256B。
description.en: The title of the video. The title can contain Chinese characters, English letters, digits, and hyphens (-). The title cannot start with a special character and must not exceed 256 bytes in length.

description.zh: 用户自定义数据，获取结果时原样返回。长度不超过 1024 字节。
description.en: The user-defined data. The service returns this data unmodified in the callback notification. This parameter cannot exceed 1,024 bytes.

title.zh: 提交视频智能内容理解任务

descriptions.zh: 该接口为[异步接口](~~3027141~~)，提交任务后返回任务ID（此时任务尚未完成，任务将进入后台排队异步执行），最终结果将通过回调通知，也可通过[查询智能内容理解任务](~~2975154~~)主动查询任务状态。
descriptions.en: This is an [asynchronous API](~~3027141~~). After you submit a job, the service returns a job ID and queues it for processing. The final results are delivered via a callback notification. You can also check the job status by calling the [QueryIntelligentContentUnderstandingTask](~~2975154~~) operation.
